verdict.rationale: Groq documents LoRA adapter upload and serving, allowing users to run inference with pre-made LoRA adapters and deploy multiple specialized adapters alongside a base model, covering the LoRA part of the story. There is no evidence of uploading or serving fully custom fine-tuned base model weights outside the LoRA framework. missing for 10: evidence of custom full-weight model upload and serving, independent hands-on confirmation of the LoRA upload workflow, details on supported base models and adapter size limits.
